status: Illustrative until calibrated with the engineering partners (spec/features/risk_matrix.md). Every value carries its basis: a source number from docs/sources.md, a decision, or 'assumption'.

end_zone.name: end zone (near a joint or support, where bars are anchored or lapped)
end_zone.basis: [46] ch. 2.1, 2.3: splitting starts where the bar is anchored; anchorages with cracks along bars. Diagonal shear near supports: assumption, to confirm. Length of the zone (about one element depth): assumption.

unknown.name: location unknown
unknown.basis: AGENTS.md rule 2: doubt never lowers a level

growing.name: the crack has grown since the last photo
growing.basis: [46] ch. 5.3; D23: only growth larger than the measurement uncertainty

sticking_openings.name: doors or windows started to stick

recent_earthquake.name: an earthquake since the crack was last seen

added_floors.name: floors were added to the building

thin_cover.name: thin cover or no stirrups where the bar is exposed
thin_cover.basis: [46] ch. 2.3.3 (cover of 1 bar diameter: brittle failure), ch. 3.2 (thin cover and no transverse reinforcement: brittle splitting). Line of 'about one bar diameter': assumption.

crossing_bar_crack.name: the crack meets a crack along a bar or stirrup
crossing_bar_crack.basis: [46] ch. 4.4: cracks along stirrups lower the bond; ch. 2.1

damp.name: damp, water marks or moss at the crack
damp.basis: assumption: [46] ch. 6.2 lists these signs as not yet evaluated; Eurocode 2 exposure classes not yet read

offset.name: one side of the crack is displaced
offset.basis: v2 (D20); measured as sliding larger than its uncertainty, about 2 px [46] ch. 5.1, 5.2

sagging.name: visible sagging of a beam or slab

next_steps.Low: Routine monitoring: photograph the same crack again in 6 months.
next_steps.Medium: Low-cost advice; photograph the same crack again in 1 month. If it has grown, it goes to an engineer.
next_steps.High: An engineer must confirm; the case is sent now.
next_steps.Expert needed: An engineer decides; the case is sent now.
next_steps.Retake: Retake the photo following the protocol.
